Subject: Proposed virtual onsite — multi-slot plan (REQ-2026-1423)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for your time on the phone Tuesday — excited to move you to a virtual onsite for the Senior ML Engineer role. Below is a proposed multi-slot plan (Pacific times). If anything here conflicts with your constraints, let me know and we can iterate:

- 10:00–10:30 AM — Systems design (Karthik)
- 10:40–11:10 AM — Model evaluation & infra (Laura)
- 11:20–11:50 AM — Team fit / leadership (Ava)
- 12:00–12:30 PM — Async take-home discussion / wrap (panel scribe)

We reserved a 30-minute buffer after the second slot for any overrun or short break for you. Please confirm availability for Tuesday 17 Nov or Wednesday 18 Nov (PST).

Attached: candidate_resume.pdf (stub) — I'll circulate a more detailed panel agenda and runbook once we lock times.

Thanks,
Marissa

Folks,

Thanks — Jordan's hard stop at 12:45 is noted. Two small requests from the hiring side:

1) Can we reorder slots so technical deep-dive (Model evaluation & infra) happens first? That helps unblock a follow-up on infra trade-offs if we need depth. So:
   - 10:00–10:30 — Model evaluation & infra (Laura)
   - 10:40–11:10 — Systems design (Karthik)
   - 11:20–11:50 — Team fit / leadership (Ava)

2) Please assign a shadow interviewer for the tech slots (rotate Neha as shadow for the first slot). Shadow should be marked optional on the invites so Jordan doesn't get extra meeting fatigue, but they can drop in to take notes.

3) Add a 20-minute optional take-home sync at 12:15 as an overflow only (we try to avoid using it unless the candidate opts in).

Marissa — can you send an updated calendar invite with clear 'optional' flags and the Zoom links? I can own the model evaluation slot and will prep a three-question rubric.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
